_comment: Automatic spec-status rules read by crew-ls.py --reconcile (report) and crew-task.py reconcile --apply (writes); tried in file order, first match wins. kind: done (ready to mark done: a PR is open), pr-open (a PR is open, the done rule fails), ready (to open a PR) and stalled are report-only; hold rewrites Status using `status` and logs `log` (fields: idle_days, prior, from_state). Predicates are defined in task_state.py. DONE is written only by `crew-task.py mark-done`, from crew open pr or by hand; IMPLEMENTING only by `crew-task.py mark-implementing`.
